title: Reviewers sign in by key variable only
summary: Removes the login-file seeding path from the reviewer runner. `Review::login_paths` and `Reviewer::login_paths` are gone, along with `RunHome::seed_login`, `real_home`, `copy_login` and `copy_dir`; a reviewer's fresh home is now always empty. In exchange, `run_with_retry` gains a `missing_credential` gate: a reviewer whose agent defines no credential variable, or whose variables are all unset or empty, returns could-not-run with a reason that names the variable and never its value. Run notes are now always empty, and the docs and ADRs are reworded to match.

nodes.label: review_run
nodes.subtitle: Attempt.notes
nodes.summary: The saved run record. Only the doc comment on `Attempt::notes` changed: notes are now empty for a run that noted nothing, since the login-path notes are gone.

nodes.label: reviewers
nodes.subtitle: run_one / run_with_retry
nodes.summary: The reviewer runner. Loses the login-seeding machinery and gains the credential gate that refuses a reviewer with no key variable before any child is spawned.

nodes.label: run_one_noted
nodes.subtitle: (Outcome, Vec<String>, Option<Cause>)
nodes.summary: Still returns notes for the caller, but the vector is now always empty; the notes plumbing through `run_with_retry` and `run_child` is deleted.

nodes.label: missing_credential
nodes.subtitle: fn missing_credential(&Reviewer) -> Option<String>
nodes.summary: New gate. Returns a reason when the agent defines no credential variable at all, or when none of its variables is set to a non-empty value. The reason names variables, never values.

nodes.label: run_with_retry
nodes.subtitle: first run + one retry
nodes.summary: Calls `missing_credential` right after the read-only check and returns could-not-run on a hit. No longer takes a notes vector or a real home.

nodes.label: prepare_command
nodes.subtitle: (Command, RunHome)
nodes.summary: Creates the fresh home and builds the allow-listed environment. The login-seeding branch and the empty-key note are gone, so it returns two values instead of three.

nodes.label: run_child
nodes.subtitle: one harness attempt
nodes.summary: Spawns the harness with the prepared command. Drops the `real_home` and `notes` parameters and the note de-duplication loop.

nodes.label: RunHome
nodes.subtitle: fresh empty home
nodes.summary: The temporary home a reviewer runs in. `seed_login` is removed, so the home is created empty and only `apply`/`apply_temp`/`Drop` remain.

nodes.label: seed_login / copy_login
nodes.subtitle: deleted
nodes.summary: The copy path that pulled declared login files out of the real home into the reviewer's home, plus `real_home`, `copy_login` and `copy_dir`. Nothing replaces it: the home stays empty.

nodes.label: Reviewer
nodes.subtitle: login_paths removed
nodes.summary: The runtime reviewer description loses its `login_paths` field; `credential_env` is now the only sign-in channel it carries.

nodes.label: AGENTS
nodes.subtitle: the one list
nodes.summary: Each agent's `Review` entry drops `login_paths`; `credential_env` gains a doc note that an empty list means the agent can never start as a reviewer. omp is the one entry with an empty list.

nodes.label: Review
nodes.subtitle: credential_env only
nodes.summary: The per-agent review facts. `login_paths` is deleted and `credential_env` is documented as the sole sign-in path, with an empty list meaning the agent never reviews.

nodes.label: dsh / omp / opencode / codex / claude
nodes.subtitle: login_paths dropped
nodes.summary: The five agent entries each lose their `login_paths` literal. Their `credential_env` values are unchanged: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, none, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, CODEX_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.

nodes.label: Reviewer harness
nodes.subtitle: codex / claude / opencode / dsh
nodes.summary: The coding agent itself, run headless. It now starts with an empty home and signs in only from the credential variable in its environment.

nodes.label: reviewer tests
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/tests
nodes.summary: The fake reviewer now declares a dummy key variable and sets it once, and the integration harness injects a dummy value for every agent's key so runs still start. The login-copy unit tests are deleted.

nodes.label: ADR 0016 the review check
nodes.subtitle: security posture
nodes.summary: Reworded: osf copies no login file, a reviewer signs in only through its key variable, and does not start when that variable is unset. Stale PR links are dropped.

nodes.label: ADR 0020 who can post
nodes.subtitle: secret containment
nodes.summary: Same rewording of the login-file rule, plus the amendment history in the Date line is trimmed back to the original date.

nodes.label: development.md
nodes.subtitle: agent table
nodes.summary: Documents the new rule and adds a table of each agent's key variable and what happens when it is unset; omp is listed as having no variable and so never reviewing.

nodes.label: crates/osf README
nodes.subtitle: agent list
nodes.summary: Says a reviewer runs in a fresh empty home with only its own credential variables, and reports could-not-run when its variable is unset.
